title: 第13章 强大的先天道体第14章 不配我出手
content_zh:
第13章强大的先天道体“能把上面的人拉下来，才更有趣！”
听到萧沉的话，不少人露出一缕异色，这是想将观战席上的三大势力，都拉下来？
“的确，很有趣。”
有人笑道，也不知是在说这件事，还是认为萧沉太天真了。
“狂妄！”
周狂昭怒而起身，双眸之中尽皆怒气，“以为投靠了白家，有了靠山，就可以如此放肆吗！”
“我没有寻找靠山的想法，倒是周家主，找到了主人以后，气性都大了不少。”
萧沉淡淡笑道。
“白家，就任由此子在这里放肆吗？”
周家有长老人物喝道。
“你似乎忘了，如今的白家和周家，是什么关系。
开战，是你们提出的。”
白念冰露出戏谑之色。
“那好，白家不管的话，就由老夫代劳，教训这个叛徒！”
周家的三长老漫步而出，长袖之中绽放一柄杀伐之剑，径直劈杀向萧沉。
就在这时，白家到场的五位长老人物尽皆踏步走出，神色锋利，站在萧沉的面前！
周家三长老的利剑停了下来，阴沉地盯着面前的五人，“让开！”
五位长老对视一眼，脚步同时向前一踏。
咚！
地面震颤，白家五位长老没有释放境界气息，却有一股狂猛的气浪朝着周三长老扑去，让他神色惊变，仿佛滔天海浪拍打而下，要将他淹没。

“咳咳。”
周家三长老疯狂后退，灰头土脸，有些狼狈。
人群一惊，有五位长老护着萧沉，他在白家，是什么地位？
轰！
周狂昭身上骤然间爆发出一股强盛的气息，“白家，欺人太甚！”
“周家以长老来对付我白家参加大比的后辈，此手段何其卑劣！
你周狂昭若出手，我保证，今日周家前来参加大比之人，全都有来无回！”
白家一位长老厉声开口，使得所有人的眼眸都凝了下，萧沉，是今日白家派出参加大比之人？
“白家无人了吗，派一个修为尽失的人参加大比？”
“我听说萧沉修行了一身毒术，也许是想凭借着毒术取胜吧。”
“我就不信，祁天学府会看中一个无法修行的废物。”
对三大家族而言，远风城大比关乎矿脉之争，而对于其他远风城的年轻人来说，祁天学府，才是他们力争的机会！
“即便是白家的老辈人物，也没有资格在我面前说这个话！”
此时，一道更加狂妄的声音传来，众人循声望去，只见周家的先天道体，周凌雪，正朝着观战席踏步而来。
她那近乎完美的身躯，似与天地相合，充斥着神秘的气息，仿佛是真正秉承天地大道而生的存在。
嗡！
突然，周凌雪出手了，周身似有大道气息弥漫，苦海咆哮，强势的一掌径直拍向了那白家长老，犹如摧枯拉朽一般。
白家长老踏步迎击而上，同样轰出一掌，纯白色的真元之光闪烁，两股力量碰撞到一起，发出沉闷的声响！
这一击之下，白家长老后退数步，神情骇然，而周凌雪依旧如同人间仙子，不染尘埃。
“先天道体果然强大，深不可测！”

“她已经能力撼老辈人物了，今日大比，谁与争锋？”
“难怪能惊动祁天学府，不止是王家的功劳，周凌雪自身也是极强啊！”
content_en:
Chapter 13 The powerful innate Taoist body “It’s more interesting if you can pull down the people on top!”
Hearing Xiao Chen's words, many people showed a strange look. Are they trying to pull down all the three major forces in the spectator seats?
"Indeed, it's interesting."
Someone laughed, not knowing whether they were talking about this or thinking that Xiao Chen was too naive.
"Arrogant!"
Zhou Kuangzhao stood up angrily, his eyes full of anger, "Do you think that since you have taken refuge in the Bai family and have a backer, you can be so unrestrained!"
"I have no idea of ​​looking for a backer. On the contrary, the head of the Zhou family has become much more angry after finding the master."
Xiao Chen smiled lightly.
"The Bai family, are you going to let this son run wild here?"
An elder from the Zhou family shouted.
"You seem to have forgotten what the relationship between the Bai family and the Zhou family is now.
It was you who proposed the war. "
Bai Nianbing showed a joking expression.
"Well, if the Bai family doesn't care, let me do it for you and teach this traitor a lesson!"
The third elder of the Zhou family strolled out, a killing sword blooming from his long sleeves, and struck directly at Xiao Chen.
At this moment, all five elders from the Bai family stepped out with sharp expressions and stood in front of Xiao Chen!
The third elder of the Zhou family stopped with his sharp sword and stared gloomily at the five people in front of him, "Get out of the way!"
The five elders looked at each other and stepped forward at the same time.
Boom!
The ground trembled. The five elders of the Bai family did not release their realm aura, but a violent wave of air rushed towards Elder Zhou Zhou, making his expression change with shock, as if a huge wave was crashing down and trying to drown him.
"Ahem."
The third elder of the Zhou family retreated crazily, looking disgraced and a little embarrassed.
The crowd was shocked. There were five elders protecting Xiao Chen. What was his status in the Bai family?
boom!
Zhou Kuangzhao suddenly burst out with a powerful aura, "The Bai family is going too far!"
"The Zhou family uses the elders to deal with the descendants of the Bai family who are participating in the competition. This method is so despicable!
If you, Zhou Kuangzhao, take action, I guarantee that everyone from the Zhou family who came to participate in the competition today will never come back! "
An elder of the Bai family spoke sharply, causing everyone's eyes to freeze. Xiao Chen, is this the person sent by the Bai family to participate in the competition today?
"Is there no one in the Bai family? Send a person who has lost all his cultivation to participate in the competition?"
"I heard that Xiao Chen has practiced poison skills. Maybe he wants to win with poison skills."
"I don't believe that Qitian Academy would like a loser who can't practice."
For the three major families, the Far Wind City Competition is about the battle for mineral deposits, but for the other young people in Far Wind City, Qitian Academy is the opportunity they strive for!
"Even the elders of the Bai family are not qualified to say this in front of me!"
At this time, an even more arrogant voice came, and everyone followed the sound and saw Zhou Lingxue, the innate Taoist body of the Zhou family, walking towards the spectator seats.
Her nearly perfect body seemed to be in harmony with heaven and earth, and was filled with a mysterious aura, as if she was truly born to uphold the principles of heaven and earth.
Buzz!
Suddenly, Zhou Lingxue took action. The aura of the great road seemed to permeate his body, and the sea of ​​bitterness roared. He struck the elder of the Bai family with a powerful palm, as if it was destroying everything.
The elder of the Bai family stepped forward to meet the attack, and also blasted out a palm. The pure white light of true energy flashed, and the two forces collided together, making a dull sound!
Under this blow, the elders of the Bai family took a few steps back, looking horrified, but Zhou Lingxue was still like a fairy on earth, untainted by dust.
"The innate Dao body is really powerful and unfathomable!"
"She is already capable of defeating the elders. Who can compete with her in today's competition?"
"No wonder it's not only the Wang family's contribution to alarming Qitian Academy, Zhou Lingxue herself is also extremely powerful!"
